name: Camping 101: Leatherworking

angles.text: Making portable leather shelters suits the tauren tribes' nomadic traditions and wilderness survival heritage across Mulgore's plains.
Horde travelers crossing Kalimdor's wide, arid lands rely on rugged camping gear far from fortified strongholds.
Cooking trainers teach travelers to build a proper campfire, completing a leather tent's warm campsite.

faq.answer: Leatherworkers learn to make a tent for their travels. It shelters them from harsh weather and gives them a place to rest in the wilderness.
faq.q: What does this quest teach leatherworkers?

faq.answer: Chaw Stronghide teaches tent making in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He shares the craft once a leatherworker proves able to handle heavier hides and rugged stitching.
faq.q: Who teaches leatherworkers how to craft camp tents?

faq.answer: Pitch camp in the open wilderness, away from populated settlements. Town residents and village elders do not want private shelters in town squares or along roads.
faq.q: Where can travelers set up their camp tents?

aliases: why do i need a campfire
faq.answer: A campfire brings warmth and protection to a wilderness camp. Visit a skilled cook to learn how to kindle one before traveling into the wild.
faq.q: Why is a campfire needed alongside a tent?

faq.answer: Bloodhoof Village lies in central Mulgore, south of Thunder Bluff along the shores of Stonebull Lake. The tauren settlement serves hunters, gatherers and artisans, and offers training, trade supplies and guidance to travelers exploring the plains.

Cooking is not needed to stitch a leather tent, but cooks teach travelers how to kindle campfires. A fire completes an outdoor camp, warms the night air and lets travelers prepare food on long journeys.
faq.q: Do you need cooking skill to maintain a proper campsite?

faq.answer: A tent shelters travelers from intense heat and heavy rain. Resting inside helps them stay refreshed and alert as they explore distant territories.
faq.q: What benefits does a camp tent provide to a traveler?

sections.body: Across Kalimdor, leatherworkers who know how to stitch a sturdy tent can shelter from the midday sun and prairie rain. A tent also gives weary travelers a place to rest and recover before crossing the open plains again.
sections.title: Shelters for the Open Plains

sections.body: At Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, Chaw Stronghide teaches leatherworkers who can handle heavier hides and rugged stitching. Once they prove their skill, he shows them how to make a durable tent for journeys far from civilization.
sections.title: The Craft of Chaw Stronghide

sections.body: Choose a camp with care and respect for local settlements. Village folk frown on travelers setting up along central paths and thoroughfares, so take your tent into the wild frontier. A proper camp also needs a fire. Ask a skilled cook how to kindle one.
sections.title: Camps in the Wild

summary: In Bloodhoof Village, leatherworkers can learn to make a tent for shelter on the road. Chaw Stronghide teaches the craft to those ready to handle heavier hides and rugged stitching.
